reason: workflow declares this stage approval: required
summary: Add consistent errors and security controls, management-token throttling, loopback-only Actuator metrics, and low-cardinality redirect observability without changing link retention or redirect destinations.
decisions: Persistence and migrations: Make no schema or retention changes and create no migration. (agent)

Management-token limiter: Use a shared in-memory rolling 60-second limiter keyed by the direct peer address; count only supplied incorrect tokens and calculate Retry-After from the oldest blocking attempt. (agent)
Redirect metrics: Record a redirect counter and duration with fixed outcome tags for 302, 404, 410, and 5xx, with no code or cause tags. (agent)
Database outage boundary: Return 503 for database failure during the required link lookup, while retaining best-effort click-write behavior. (agent)
Request body enforcement: Enforce 16 KiB on bytes actually received for /api/** and return the standard JSON 413 response before MVC processing. (agent)
Actuator listener: Use a separate management port, configured as 8081, bound to 127.0.0.1, exposing only /actuator/health and /actuator/metrics. (agent)
